abilities.effect: The web lurker noose makes a noose Strike against the triggering creature.
abilities.name: Web Noose

traits.name: Attack
traits.text: An ability with this trait involves an attack. For each attack you make beyond the first on your turn, you take a multiple attack penalty.

abilities.trigger: A creature steps into the square with the web tripwire.

damage.effect: pulled off the ground (Escape DC 22). The target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns as long as it’s caught in the noose.

hazard.description: Discreet webbing at throat level snags a creature that walks into it.
hazard.disable: Survival (trained) or Thievery (expert) DC 18 to rearrange the webbing
hazard.name: Web Lurker Noose

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
